message.content:
This is a palm fatty acid distillate prill used as a feed supplement. The main candidates are in Chapter 38 (3823, industrial monocarboxylic fatty acids; acid oils from refining) and Chapter 23 (2309, animal feed preparations).

I recall a CBP ruling on a similar product, "NUTRACOR 80P" (possibly NY N-series), which classified it under 3823.19.0000 (industrial monocarboxylic fatty acids; acid oils from refining: other). Palm fatty acid distillate is an acid oil from refining or a distilled fatty acid, so heading 3823 fits. The prill form and its use as a feed supplement do not change that, since it is not a preparation of a kind used in animal feeding with other components.

The HTS subheadings are 3823.11 (stearic acid), 3823.12 (oleic acid), 3823.13 (tall oil fatty acids), and 3823.19 (other). Within 3823.19, the 10-digit codes are 3823.19.1000 (distilled fatty acids) and 3823.19.2000 (fatty acid distillate), with 3823.19.40 and 3823.19.90 covering other. A palm fatty acid distillate falls under 3823.19.20 as "Fatty acid distillate", and the statistical suffix would be 3823.19.2000.
